verdict.rationale: Better Stack can create Linear tickets from incidents using AI-suggested fixes, and it generates automated post-mortems. That covers pushing incident follow-ups into an issue tracker. There is no evidence that these action items are tracked to completion inside Better Stack, that ticket status syncs back, or that trackers other than Linear are supported. The incident todo list applies at trigger time and is not a post-incident follow-up tracker. Missing for 10: tracking of follow-up actions through to completion, two-way status sync with the issue tracker, support for trackers beyond Linear, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker
